messages:
Alex G.: noticed odd 429 waterfall when running the C# sample app with parallel paginators (concurrency=6). only reproducible on netcore 3.1 image.
Tori N.: can you share the command + short log?
Alex G.: run: `dotnet run --sample onboard_pagination --concurrency 6 --sdk csharp` then feed 5k items. after ~20s we see: `WARN backpressure triggered worker=4` then many `ERROR 429 route=/v1/embeds` within a 3s window. logs: ```2024-05-02T11:12:04Z INFO starting paginator worker=2
2024-05-02T11:12:24Z WARN tokenbucket empty worker=2 refill_ms=200
2024-05-02T11:12:27Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds detail=rate_limit_exceeded
```
Chris M.: interesting — C# SDK uses a shared System.Timers.Timer for refill across workers; timers on mono/netcore can coalesce which might cause synchronized refill and bursts.
Tori N.: do other SDKs use per-worker timers or jitter?
Chris M.: JS/Py use jittered per-worker refills by default. Go has a pooled refill but picks random offsets. C# currently doesn't add jitter.
Alex G.: quick local hack: changed refill to `Task.Delay(refillMs + Random(0,refillJitter))` per worker and decreased refillMs from 200 to 60. immediate reduction in spikes in 10k run.
Tori N.: good find. can you open a PR to add jitter + make timer implementation use `Stopwatch`+`Task.Delay` to avoid OS timer coalescing? also add a small per-request reservation so a paginator doesn't grab entire window.
Chris M.: will do. i'll also add an integration test in devex harness: run 6 concurrent paginators x 2 SDK images (csharp, python) and assert <5 429s in any 5s interval.
ci-bot: test job queued: devex/integration/concurrency-regressions (build 4091) :white_check_mark:
Alex G.: also we should add a short note in onboarding readme: "C# users: avoid concurrency >4 on older runtimes; upgrade to net6+ or set refill_jitter_ms>=50". i'll open docs PR.
Tori N.: thanks, good short-term mitigation. long-term we should standardize token-bucket semantics across SDKs (per-worker reservations + jitter + non-blocking auth refresh).
Alex G.: tagging @Chris M. and @Tori N. repro artifacts in `examples/csharp/onboard/throttle-repro` and a script to reproduce. closing for now. :thumbsup:
